name: Northern Lincolnshire and Goole NHS Foundation Trust (Estates)
summary: NHS trust whose Estates, Facilities and Development team has hosted Maintenance, Installation and Repair T Level students at Diana, Princess of Wales Hospital in Grimsby and Scunthorpe General Hospital.
how_to_apply: Ask your college's industry placement team. The trust's 2024 placements came through the Grimsby Institute (Tec Partnership) and North Lindsey College.
sites: Diana, Princess of Wales Hospital, Grimsby|DN33 2BA;Scunthorpe General Hospital|DN15 7BH

name: The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust (Clinical Engineering)
summary: NHS trust whose clinical engineering department hosts Engineering T Level industry placement students from Telford College, one of the first hospital clinical engineering teams to do so.
how_to_apply: Through Telford College's industry placement team; the partnership started at a careers fair on the college's Wellington campus.

name: Northumbria Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
summary: NHS trust that offers industry placements for T Level Engineering students (as well as T Level Health). Which engineering teams and sites take students isn't stated.

name: ABP Food Group (Shrewsbury)
summary: ABP Food Group's Shrewsbury food production site has hosted T Level students from Shrewsbury College, including a Design and Development for Engineering and Manufacturing student specialising in electrical and electronic engineering.
how_to_apply: Through Shrewsbury College's industry placement team, which has placed T Level students with ABP Shrewsbury.
